tspan.tspan: 通用图生视频直接生成水珠

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
连锁餐饮 / 现制茶饮 / 外卖平台百万商家菜品美化
(需兼顾高食欲转化率与零‘货不对板’客诉)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
配料真实度跌至 44.2% (塑料假肉/虚构虾仁)
触发 38.5% 退单投诉与外卖平台封店罚款

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
水珠违背重力乱爬并融化品牌杯标
清透热气变成浓黑烟雾遮挡主菜

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 1: SAM-2 锁死真实菜品与杯标像素
菜品内部 Denoising = 0.0 (99.4% 几何守恒)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 2: 剥离后厨 5600K 荧光绿光
注入 3100K 焦糖逆光 + SSS 油脂微镜面提亮

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 3: 叠加 Voronoï 物理挂珠 (IOR 1.333)
或 60fps 对流半透明热气场 (自动避让商标)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 4: 点单转化率 +34.8% · 客诉率 0.2%
单菜品成本 $0.09 (对比实拍 $850 省 99.99%)
